title: SessionEventRequest
description: POST /api/v1/telescopes/:slug/sessions (scope sessions:write, api_revision 1). session_end queues a night_ready command for every processing node serving the telescope, one per optical train. target_start (api_revision 5) says Target Scheduler started imaging the targets in target_ids: they become in_progress and show as being imaged now; observing_nights are untouched.
